mkp-cs:structure@1.name: structure
mkp-cs:structure@1.about: A data structure step by step (array, stack, queue, linked list or binary tree) in a frame: the marked items lit, a note for each step in the bar, played or stepped through.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: how the items are laid out

inputs.name: states
inputs.about: one state per step: the items (front, top or root first; a tree in level order with "" for a gap), a note, and the places to mark

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the header's title

values.name: depth
comment: a tree in level order: item i has children 2i+1 and 2i+2, at depth floor(log2(i+1))

values.name: most
comment: the largest state, so the stage keeps one size as it plays

value.expr: max([0] + map(states, x => max([0] + map(filter(range(0, len(x.items) - 1), i => x.items[i] != ""), i => depth(i)))))
filter(real, it => it.i > 0 and at(st.items, floor((it.i - 1) / 2), "") != "")

values.name: place
values.body: {id: "p" + i, i: i, label: at(st.items, i, ""), on: indexof(st.marked, i) >= 0}
comment: a tree in rows of places, 2^d at depth d, each node centred over its children's; a row of more
than eight places is a row of groups of eight, as a grid has at most twelve columns

value.expr: map(range(0, maxdepth), d => {id: "level" + d, groups: map(range(0, max(1, floor(2^d / 8)) - 1), g => {id: "g" + d + "-" + g, places: map(range(2^d - 1 + 8 g, min(2^(d + 1) - 2, 2^d - 1 + 8 g + 7)), i => place(i))})})
if(kind == array, "Array", if(kind == stack, "Stack", if(kind == queue, "Queue", if(kind == linked, "Linked list", "Tree"))))

comment: an index over every cell, as a table's header row

md.expr: join(map(range(0, len(states) - 1), k => "" + (k + 1) + ". " + if(kind == tree, "level order: ", if(kind == stack, "top first: ", if(kind == queue, "front first: ", ""))) + listmd(states[k]) + if(states[k].note == "", "", " (" + states[k].note + ")")), "\n") + "\n"

args.fn: local:mkp-cs:structure@1:listmd#0<{items: list(text), note: text, marked: list(int)}>
